device.soc: ALi M3606 (M3602 family with dual-CPU MIPS32 + SEE co-processor)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.2.0), maincode container 0x020000 (LZMA -> 5.51 MB maincode at 0x80000200, 2.30 MB SEE at 0xA1A00200) -- the whole 8 MB flash

source.note: Opticum / Globo HD XC406p DVB-C official firmware.

simulator.note: Boots as M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603: the bootloader starts the SEE at 0xA1E90290, unpacks maincode to 0x80000200 and SEE to 0xA6000200, prints 'model = HD X406p' and 'MC: APP  init ok'.

desc: The v1.07.5468 firmware of the Opticum HD XC406p DVB-C HD cable receiver built on the dual-core ALi M3606 SoC.
Features a dual-CPU architecture (main MIPS32 application core and secondary SEE co-processor) running SDK4.0ba.4.2.
